findings.title: Current controller Source author can satisfy the independent review gates
findings.counterexample: Exact C5 gate and unchanged O3 validate_source_review both accept actor_id codex:/root/live_resource_lookup with otherwise correct schema/decision/callback/complete six refs/formal=false.
findings.impact: The actual C5 author may supply the review accepted as independent for this Source tuple; the old Root/w05 exclusion list no longer covers the current tuple authors.
findings.requested_change: Bind the current Source tuple authors at the pre-import admission boundary and reject any matching reviewer identity, including the C5 controller author. Preserve exact six-ref checks and ensure the observer path cannot be used to bypass that author binding.

findings.title: Reconciliation releases retained protection from an unbound callback result
counterexamples: With current clock 100 and retained time 100, observed_monotonic=1000000 is accepted and releases both guard/watchdog.

A free callback returning matching run_uuid/owner_pid and a clean-looking native_result releases guard/watchdog and removes the resident record without any verified cleanup-producer source or retained Job/child identity. A foreign producer/Job marker is ignored because no such binding is present.
findings.impact: The original unconfirmed-Job retention can be ended without evidence that its actual remaining consumers have terminated; dictionary shape and a lower-bound timestamp do not establish a fresh owned-Job observation.
findings.requested_change: Require an independently reviewed, exact-byte-bound cleanup producer that executes under retained Source protection (or implement the query internally in the reviewed module). Bind its proof to the actual retained Job and child PID/creation identity, not only the parent PID/run label. Validate a finite observation time within the fresh call's actual start/end window; retain all resources on any missing/mismatched provenance or cleanup field. Preserve the same-PID owner/residency prerequisite and do not turn recovery into a new model attempt or reset a deadline/budget.
findings.schema_note: The foreign marker control demonstrates the absence of producer/Job binding; it does not claim those optional marker fields are part of the current published schema.
